<script>document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir","rtl");</script>
<style>
@keyframes ab-gd{from{transform:scaleY(.04);opacity:0}to{transform:scaleY(1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes ab-gu{from{transform:scaleY(.05);opacity:0}to{transform:scaleY(1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes ab-pp{from{transform:scale(0);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes ab-fi{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
#ab-hero{text-align:center;margin:.5rem 0 2rem}
#ab-hero svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto}
#ab-hero .node{cursor:pointer}
#ab-hero .node:hover{filter:brightness(1.18)}
#ab-hero .node:hover text{fill:#fff}
#ab-hero .anim-roots{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 0%;animation:ab-gd 1.3s ease .4s both}
#ab-hero .anim-trunk{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:ab-gu .8s ease 1.6s both}
#ab-hero .anim-wood{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:ab-gu 1s ease 2.3s both}
#ab-hero .anim-foliage{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 62%;animation:ab-pp 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1) 3.1s both}
#ab-hero .anim-fruits{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 60%;animation:ab-pp .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1) 4.3s both}
#ab-hero .lbl-root{opacity:0;animation:ab-fi .6s ease 1.5s both}
#ab-hero .lbl-trunk-box{opacity:0;animation:ab-fi .6s ease 2.3s both}
#ab-hero .lbl-wood{opacity:0;animation:ab-fi .6s ease 3.6s both}
#ab-hero .lbl-fruit{opacity:0;animation:ab-fi .6s ease 4.7s both}
#ab-hero .legend{opacity:0;animation:ab-fi .8s ease 5.1s both}
#ab-hero .ab-cap{min-height:22px;color:#37b47e;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin:8px 12px}
#ab-hero .ab-btn{margin-top:2px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--bs-border-color,#2a5064);background:transparent;color:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#ab-hero .anim-zones{opacity:0;animation:ab-fi .8s ease 5.3s both}
#ab-hero .zone-sol rect{transition:fill .15s,stroke .15s}
#ab-hero .zone-sol:hover rect{fill:#523c21;stroke:#d8a660}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#ab-hero [class*="anim-"],#ab-hero [class*="lbl-"],#ab-hero .legend{animation:none;opacity:1;transform:none}}
#ab-hero .anim-wood polygon,
#ab-hero .anim-wood circle{stroke:#2b1a0c;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linejoin:round}
</style>
